label: thunder cloud: forming
description: After16 animation frames enters state1.

label: thunder cloud: active
description: At frame5 creates fire and deals area damage; at frame10 enters state2.

label: thunder cloud: disappearing
description: Counts frames down and deletes the cloud when frame reaches zero.

label: rain cloud: forming
description: After16 animation frames enters state1.

label: rain cloud: active
description: Raining/extinguishing requires activity17. After its rain-cycle timer expires enters state2.

label: rain cloud: disappearing
description: Counts frames down and deletes the cloud when frame reaches zero.

label: Farm at rest
description: No farm state-animation update runs.

label: Farm feeding animation
description: Draws feed.mfb and returns to state0 when its timer reaches250.

label: Farm rooster animation
description: Changes rooster frames at timer1/36 and returns to state0 at80.

label: Farm cowshed animation
description: Draws cowshed.mfb, plays a cow sound at timer50 and returns to state0 after100.

label: Farm pig animation
description: Draws pigsy.mfb, plays a pig sound at timer50 and returns to state0 after100.
